# Will the diagnostic_updater lock the controller execution and disrupt real-time performance when holding controllers_lock_?

> **Current answer:** The mutex was fixed to list the storage controllers, preventing changes during non-real-time callback reads; loading itself is not part of the real-time path. Therefore, the comment 'lock controllers' cannot directly infer that the update is locked. However, the original thread lacks a delay benchmark, and the target version still applies path auditing and cycle measurement. The credibility is limited as there is no formal cross-verification or independent replication available.
